text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"“It is then that the conclusion can be reached…”","quality":"clear thesis","description":"The essay states a definite position early and keeps that position visible throughout."},{"evidence":"three body paragraphs with separate points","quality":"organizational control","description":"The essay is arranged into distinct parts that each develop a different reason rather than a loose stream of claims."},{"evidence":"“presently, traffic laws are written…”","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"The essay incorporates a relevant detail from the article to support its argument instead of relying only on general opinion."},{"evidence":"“Therefore,” “Yet,” “It is with probable evidence, then”","quality":"logical transitions","description":"The essay uses connective language to show relationships between claims and to guide the reader through the argument."},{"evidence":"“The lives of the innocent… should not be risked for the sake of progress.”","quality":"concluding force","description":"The essay ends with a strong summary statement that reinforces its overall stance."}]}
